summary.text: Stacy Zinn is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 52, appointed by the Yellowstone County Commissioners in December 2025 to replace Bill Mercer, and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Elizabeth Heald.

paragraphs.text: Zinn earned a master's degree from Texas Tech University in 1992.
Her career experience includes working for the Drug Enforcement Administration.

The Yellowstone County Commissioners appointed Zinn to the Montana House of Representatives District 52 seat on December 2, 2025, and Ballotpedia lists her as having assumed office on December 9, 2025.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
